propositions: runner.py sits at 699 LOC against a <700 assertion, leaving one line of headroom that blocks any contributor touching the runner next.
Extract build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, and record_call_spend out of run() into a new leaf module agent_call.py as plain functions with explicit parameters and no carrier object.
The extraction is a pure relocation with no changed signatures, renamed symbols, or altered logic, so the existing test suite must pass unedited.
log_call_success stays before finalize_outcome and record_call_spend stays after it to preserve the current behavior where the ok line is emitted even on finalization failure.
web_caps is passed into build_agent_kwargs rather than computed inside, keeping the _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site in runner so no monkeypatch repoints are required.
A new seam test asserts runner.py < 700 LOC, agent_call.py between 100 and 500 LOC, and that agent_call.py has no runtime import from runner.
